Documented build switch: BUILD_EXTENSION=no skips compiling the optional C speedups extension, so the package installs where it cannot be built and falls back to the pure Python apply_mask in utils.py.
The entire install payload is wrapped in sys.platform=='win32'; it exists only for Windows victims and does nothing on other platforms.

When IsUserAnAdmin() is true the code goes to state 362814, which adds the machine-wide C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu folder to the list of shortcut folders, then rejoins the non-admin path at state 18005; the admin result decides which browser shortcuts get the --load-extension argument. The CreateShortcut sink at line 90 runs on both paths; c2 only widens the set of shortcuts it rewrites, reached through state dispatch that a witness cannot express.
